name: Vitayemo v hoteli "Retributio"!
source:
Memories are a fickle thing. At first they are one, then completely different. How much will you change if you remove them in principle?
Guests of our hotel come from all over the world to experience the changes of life, not burdened by unnecessary memories.
Fine food, free drinks and unique entertainment will make your stay at the hotel unforgettable.
Book your tickets, because the number of places is limited!
We look forward to welcoming you to the 'Retributio' hotel - the place you deserve!

[Translated from [url=https://ironiclive.itch.io/retributio]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
记忆是个善变的东西。起初它们是一体的，然后就完全不同了。如果原则上删除它们，你会改变多少？
我们酒店的客人来自世界各地，体验生活的变化，而不是被不必要的回忆所负担。
精美的食物、免费饮料和独特的娱乐活动将让你在酒店度过难忘的时光。
请预订门票，因为名额有限！
我们期待你光临“Retributio”酒店——你值得拥有的地方！

[译自[url=https://ironiclive.itch.io/retributio]itch.io[/url]]
